title: Evaluating the Correctness of Inference Patterns Used by LLMs for Judgment

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual substitution of occupation phrases (e.g., replacing 'a judge' with 'a volunteer', 'a programmer', or 'a former thief') in legal case prompts, followed by extracting and quantifying the reliable and unreliable interaction effects using an AND-OR logical model to measure the model's reliance on occupation tokens for legal judgments.
